findings.clarification_subject: CH-02 air-cooled chiller: warranty expiry not stated (WAR-04)
findings.clarification_body: Please provide a corrected warranty certificate for CH-02 (Polaris Cooling PC-AC900, serial PCA9-20418) that states the warranty start and expiry date. WAR-04 gives a 12-month term from delivery (delivery note DN-4471, 14 September 2025), which would end before the planned handover on 24 November 2026. WAR-04 also mentions a possible extension to 24 months from commissioning discussed on 3 March 2026 but no written extension is attached. If an extension was agreed, please supply it in writing from the manufacturer. A promise to follow is not sufficient.
uncertainties: Actual warranty expiry date is unknown; the 14 Sep 2026 date is derived from WAR-04 terms and the delivery note quoted there.
Whether the 24-month extension from commissioning was agreed is unknown; no written extension is attached.
Commissioning date is not stated in the warranty, so an extended expiry cannot be calculated.
